headline: RBA Chief Signals Pause Following Split Rate Decision
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia's chief signaled a pause in monetary tightening following a split decision on the latest rate hike, noting prior tightening has yet to fully feed through to the economy.
why: Central bank rate decisions and forward guidance directly influence domestic currency valuations, borrowing costs, and sovereign bond yields.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: A potential pause in interest rate hikes impacts domestic lending rates and debt servicing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank governor signaled an expected pause after five rounds of tightening, altering market expectations for future policy paths and domestic yields.
